style: 古老砌石下水道，连续沟渠与拱廊

rules.title: 下水道
rules.scatter_rule: 规则重复拱架，基准100U节距乘0.83–1.18；边台和沟渠不可混作普通平地。
rules.junction_rule: 交汇井一个owner，侧出口保留净空；出水口连接沟渠不能悬空排水。
rules.top_rule: 砌石拱顶按照明决定连续覆盖范围，检查拱肩和沟渠交汇处；禁止用岩顶代替砌石。

ground.source: design_initial; measure runtime slope before acceptance

lighting.diagnostic: freeze exact camera and simulation; white ambient; fog/virtual lights disabled; bright background
lighting.acceptance: Diagnostic gaps are observations. Accept matched dark background/sky/fog joins when production lighting and supported light changes remain convincing; require local geometry for visibly lit gaps.

examples: plain brick arch, repaired arch, pipe-bearing arch
straight curb, inner turn, outer turn
damp stain, mineral crust, scrap, rubble
kit.root_policy: Channel water and walking ledge have different elevations. Arch supports land on ledge, outlets attach to a structural owner. No freestanding flat stain cards.
kit.assembly: Brick vault skin + decorative arches every 4.15-5.9m + connected ledges. Curved junction curb has explicit inside/outside pieces. Pipe outlet owns water emitter origin.
kit.light_fx: Keep green-gray reference and sparse amber accents. Outflow terminates on channel water; no drips emitted from empty ceiling pixels.
kit.junction: One junction well owns roof, channel and ledges. Interior boundaries omitted; all outgoing channels connect before decoration. No extra left/right walls as a closure workaround.
kit.lighting_acceptance: Choose open/atmospheric/hybrid/geometric. Compare diagnostic with production lighting and actual permitted changes before deciding roof asset scope.
